name: Inbox Cleaner
tagline: Sweeps a Gmail account: promotions out, subscriptions cut, keepers filed
description: Cleans out a Gmail account when you ask: the promotional pile gets cleared away, subscriptions it can cancel are cancelled, junk is binned, and the mail worth keeping is filed into the right folders. A dedicated tidy-up for anyone whose inbox has quietly become a storage problem.
author: wafflebeebz
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
